caption:
How many different diets are there in your home? Comment the number.

Every household member in WE.LIFE has their own preferences and allergens (14 EU categories); suggestions only show recipes with a confirmed absence of the marked allergens, in one meal plan for everyone. With allergies, check important decisions with a doctor: WE.LIFE helps you plan, it doesn't treat.

WE.LIFE is a Life OS for everyday life, and Food OS is its first module. The link to the free WE.LIFE beta is in our bio @welife.world. This is a beta (test) version.

Images in this video are AI-generated illustrations.

#familymeals #allergies #mealplan
